_key.description: Variant key, biosample ontology term and source file accession joined by underscores. For example NC_000001.11:14772:C:T_EFO_0002067_IGVFFI0099XJHU.

log2FC.description: Log2 fold change for the variants to biosamples edge

inputCountRef.description: Input count ref for the variants to biosamples edge

inputCountAlt.description: Input count alt for the variants to biosamples edge

outputCountRef.description: Output count ref for the variants to biosamples edge

outputCountAlt.description: Output count alt for the variants to biosamples edge

postProbEffect.description: Posterior probability that the variant has a regulatory effect.

significant.description: True when postProbEffect is greater than the STARR-seq significance threshold

CI_lower_95.description: Lower bound of a 95% interval for the variant effect.

CI_upper_95.description: Upper bound of a 95% interval for the variant effect.

enum: variant effect on regulatory element activity

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the file this measurement was read from.

biological_context.description: Plain-language summary of the biosample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata.
biological_context.example: glutamatergic neuron differentiated cell specimen, pooled cell specimen from IGVFDO6638HIAD

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for the biosample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata.

treatments_term_ids.description: Ontology term identifiers for the treatments applied to the samples for the purpose of perturbation, taken from the file's fileset metadata. Null when none were applied.
